kind: per-height sequence ledger, recomputed from raw/window-*/pending-reads.jsonl and raw/window-*/events.jsonl

section_48.asked: at least one complete real window with N >= 3 consecutive flashblocks
section_48.honest_wording: the budget is met on a minority of heights and missed on the rest, because most blocks seal before a 250 ms poll can catch them three times. Both numbers are the actual counts; the shortfall is a finding about the endpoint, not a failed run (§48: record the real number, do not fabricate).
section_48.what_the_endpoint_gives_instead: N distinct views of one height, each a longer list of the same unsealed block — so `consecutive` is counted as distinct views of a single pending height, and the count below is that count

windows.canonical_side_axis_reason: the closing arm polls `latest`; every height it jumped over is read by number and appears as a gap_fill row in reconciliation.json — measurable, because block numbers are the provider's own and frame indices are not
windows.gaps_within_a_height_reason: no wire frame index exists (§9), so a frame that never arrived cannot be told apart from one that arrived and was superseded inside the same read interval
